verdict.rationale: BigQuery's own docs describe Gemini in BigQuery and conversational analytics. Users can find, join and query tables and visualize results in natural language, and can build data agents with custom instructions and verified queries. The evidence covers natural-language data analysis, not operating the product as a whole. missing for 10: evidence of natural-language commands for administrative or operational tasks (creating datasets, loading data, managing jobs or permissions), independent or hands-on corroboration of the natural-language features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: BigQuery의 Gemini로 자연어를 사용하여 테이블 애셋을 찾고 조인하고 쿼리하고 결과를 시각화하며 전체 프로세스에서 다른 사용자와 원활하게 공동작업할 수 있습니다.
Conversational analytics lets you have natural language conversations with your data.
You can create data agents configured with custom metadata, instructions, glossary terms, and verified queries
